title: Efficacy of rTMS and tDCS as Adjunctive Rehabilitation for Cerebrovascular Disease-related Gait Dysfunction
brief_summary: This study was a prospective, randomized, single-blind, parallel-controlled, multicenter clinical study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and transcranial direct current stimulation assisted rehabilitation in the treatment of cerebrovascular disease-related gait disorders.
